data.text: Contract update for Horizon: the latest customer redline removes auto-renewal and replaces it with a fixed twelve-month term plus mutual written renewal. This supersedes the earlier draft.

prior_context.speaker: finance_dana_wu
prior_context.text: Initial working budget for Horizon is 252,000 USD before final vendor selection and operational travel adjustments. Horizonline has a separate working line and must never be used as a proxy.

prior_context.speaker: sales_rachel_ng
prior_context.text: Old exploratory commercial guidance for Horizon mentioned a maximum discount of 11%, but treat that as provisional until finance issues a current approved cap.

prior_context.speaker: legal_sofia_martinez
prior_context.text: The first Horizon contract draft still contains an auto-renewal clause. I expect that to change after current redlines land.

prior_context.speaker: security_priya_rao
prior_context.text: Vendor shortlist for Horizon is ClearHarbor versus a backup option. My focus is deployment friction, audit logging, and secret detection quality rather than a small price gap.

prior_context.speaker: assistant_erin_blake
prior_context.text: The executive sponsor asked me to hold time for a Horizon briefing, but my access is scheduling-only. I can coordinate time and broad status wording, not exact customer, budget, discount, or incident material.

prior_context.speaker: contractor_leo_park
prior_context.text: Confirming I am attached to Horizon for limited debugging support only. Until somebody says otherwise, my scope is logs and reproduction notes, not privileged configuration or customer-facing materials.

prior_context.speaker: finance_dana_wu
prior_context.text: Cross-functional sync note: legal, finance, and security are tracking separate pieces; avoid collapsing them into a single unsupported summary.

prior_context.speaker: pm_ava_lin
prior_context.text: Update: Horizon now moves from July 14, 2026 to July 24, 2026 because diligence questions added another review cycle. Treat July 24, 2026 as current until later update.

prior_context.speaker: employee_nina_torres
prior_context.text: Working note for Horizon: no change to access boundaries today; only explicitly reposted values should be treated as current.

prior_context.speaker: pm_ava_lin
prior_context.text: Coordination noise: workshop scheduling, documentation handoff, and environment checks moved around, but no policy boundary changed.
